name: Robot IP Series: Star Ranger P01
summary:
Xingxingxia P01 (星行侠P01) is an IP-character robot in Digit Robotics' product portfolio. Its official page emphasizes coordinated manipulation, perception and interaction, together with models intended to support emotional and cognitive aspects of communication. The product is presented as a recognizable robotic character rather than only an industrial mechanism.

The accessible manufacturer page provides limited text specifications. Detailed claims about mobility, endurance, payload or care functions therefore need a matching technical document before they can be used in a product comparison.
